$comment: TEMPLATE. No tokens here, ever — ${VAR} placeholders are filled in by the human at install time.

shadcn.add: claude mcp add -s user shadcn -- npx -y shadcn@latest mcp
shadcn.about: shadcn components and third-party registries. Registries are configured per project in components.json — shadcn has no global registry config.

codegraph.add: claude mcp add -s user codegraph -- codegraph serve --mcp
codegraph.about: Code graph of a project. Requires npm i -g @colbymchenry/codegraph, see codegraph/SETUP.md

github.add: claude mcp add -s user --transport http github https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}"
github.about: GitHub through the Copilot MCP endpoint. Needs a PAT with the repo scope.

figma-desktop.add: claude mcp add -s user --transport http figma-desktop http://127.0.0.1:3845/mcp
figma-desktop.about: Local Figma Desktop server. Only works while the app is running with Dev Mode MCP enabled.

firebase.add: claude mcp add firebase -- npx -y firebase-tools experimental:mcp --dir <project path>
firebase.about: Added per project rather than globally — it is bound to a directory.

MCPMagic.add: claude mcp add MCPMagic -- node "$HOME/Library/Containers/kr.co.metadata.mcp/Data/Library/Application Support/MCP Magic/mcp-server.cjs"
MCPMagic.about: The local MCP Magic app. The path only exists once that app is installed.
